feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 June 2026 4:43pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 25 June 2026 at 4:35pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing tomorrow.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure lies over northern Britain, with a shallow low to the west of the Bay of Biscay.


##Wind##

East or southeast force 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the east, becoming Variable 3 or 4 occasionally 5 in all waters tonight. Settling south or southwest 4 to 6 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then showers developing later tonight and at first tomorrow. Risk of mist/fog patches developing tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers and poor or very poor in mist/fog patches tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6, decreasing south 4 or 5 overnight into Saturday. Then increasing 5 or 6 on Saturday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mist/fog patches at first, then isolated showers Saturday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in mist/fog patches at first.
